svg.title: CHISUM: Stern ramp: electrical installation, JS3-304 revision 1
svg.text: Stern ramp: electrical installation, sheet 3 of 3 · JS3-304 · revision 1 · 12 November 2026
From where the generating sets are to stand to the last terminal of the control stand. What is not installed is drawn broken and its place is marked in the model.
Cable sizes in mm² of copper. Places: metres to port, from the transom, above the keel.
MSB 690 V (place marked: main switchboard room)
PSB 440 V section (place marked: main switchboard room)
the end at the PSB is tagged and left coiled at its place
RSP stern ramp starter panel, hydraulic pump room (ELD-51)
Connected 86.7 kW. A breaker is at least 1.25 times the full-load current; a cable is rated for its breaker; no cable loses more than 5 % (the register's rule, checked by ferry/systems/register.py).
IN THE STARTER PANEL (its door opens on them in the model)
Contactors, pump No. 1: main, delta, star
Contactors, pump No. 2: main, delta, star
Relays: cleats free, ramp locked, alarm, stop
Door lamps: power, pump 1, pump 2, cleat pump, alarm
WHERE THE FEEDS END: the places marked in the machinery spaces
Each place has a yellow outline on its floor, a sign with its tag, and the tagged ends of the cables that
are to be landed on it. The places and sizes are the machinery design basis's (sections 1.2, 2.3, 2.4): a
proposal. Nothing of the switchboards, transformers or generating sets is built.
CONTROL CIRCUIT, 24 V: the control stand's terminal strip X1 (cable W-RMP-10, 16 x 1.5 mm², in conduit E with the pipes)
Stop (opens the pumps' and the valves' circuit)
Cleats and latches free (all twelve away)
Ramp closed and locked (all fourteen home)
How it works. T10 in the starter panel makes 24 V. PUMP 1 and PUMP 2 at the stand each pull in a star-delta starter (K1, K2), which holds itself and
lights the button; STOP opens the circuit of both starters and of both solenoids of V1. The lever is spring-centred: RAISE energises V1 a, LOWER
energises V1 b, and only while a main pump's auxiliary contact is closed; LOWER also needs relay KA1 (both latches and all ten cleats away). The
cleats' valve V2 is worked with the ramp's sequence: let go before lowering, lock when the two door switches say the leaf is home. The safety latches
need no circuit to hold: each falls in by its own weight. KA2 (all fourteen switches home) lights LOCKED and goes to the bridge.

Made by ferry/yard/drawings/stern_drawing.py from ferry/systems/stern.py and the register (ferry/systems/register.py), ferry/blender/stern_place.py (arrangement revision D): the numbers the model and the register are built from.
